name: client-mcp-proxy
description: MCP proxy that exposes a remote OpenAPI-described HTTP API (MyAdmin / InterServer) as MCP tools over stdio. Tools are loaded dynamically from the OpenAPI spec at startup.
long_description:
This bundle packages the `client-mcp-proxy` PHP server as a one-click installable MCP bundle.

## What it does

* Fetches an OpenAPI 3.x spec from a configurable URL (JSON or YAML, auto-detected).
* Generates an MCP tool for every operation in the spec, with parameter schemas derived from the OpenAPI definitions.
* Forwards each tool call to the upstream HTTP API, passing through configured auth credentials (`X-API-KEY`, `Authorization: Bearer …`, or `sessionid`).
* Caches tool definitions on disk with `Last-Modified` revalidation, and falls back to the cached copy if the remote fetch fails.
* Communicates with the host application over stdio using the MCP 2025 protocol.

## Requirements

* **PHP 8.2 or newer** must be available on the user's `PATH`. Claude Desktop bundles Node.js but **not** PHP, so end users must install PHP separately:
  * macOS: `brew install php`
  * Windows: <https://windows.php.net/download/> or `winget install PHP.PHP`
  * Linux: `sudo apt install php-cli` (or distro equivalent)

The bundle ships its Composer dependencies pre-installed, so no `composer install` is required on the user's machine.

## Credentials

Set **at least one** of `API Key`, `Bearer Token`, or `Session ID` for the proxy to authenticate against the upstream API. All three are optional individually; the server simply forwards whichever are provided.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API key for the upstream MyAdmin API. Forwarded as the `X-API-KEY` header. Leave blank to use a bearer token or session id instead.

bearer_token.title: Bearer Token
bearer_token.description: OAuth / JWT bearer token. Forwarded as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Leave blank if not using bearer auth.

session_id.title: Session ID
session_id.description: Pre-existing upstream session id. Forwarded as the `sessionid` header. Leave blank if not using session auth.

openapi_spec_url.title: OpenAPI Spec URL
openapi_spec_url.description: URL the proxy fetches the OpenAPI spec from at startup. JSON and YAML are both supported and auto-detected.

api_base_url.title: Upstream API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Base URL the proxy forwards tool invocations to.

session_dir.title: Session Directory
session_dir.description: Directory the proxy uses to persist MCP session state between requests.

cache_dir.title: Cache Directory
cache_dir.description: Directory the proxy uses to cache fetched OpenAPI tool definitions.

ca_cert_file.title: CA Bundle (PEM)
ca_cert_file.description: Optional path to a PEM-format CA bundle used to verify upstream TLS certificates. Leave blank to use the system trust store.

ssl_verify.title: Verify TLS
ssl_verify.description: Verify TLS peer and host name on outbound API calls. Disable only for testing against self-signed endpoints.
